intro: Six phases, in order. The story first, then the one missable, then the nine one-shot moments, then the stranger strands, then the open-world cleanup — and the platinum lands last.

phases.description: Play the story straight through. The chapter trophies and the mission trophies pop as you go — none of them can be missed, and none of them needs a side objective. Finish the final mission for the story gold.
phases.tip: No preparation needed. Just play in order.
phases.title: Phase 1 — Play the story

phases.description: Positive Mental Attitude is the guide's only missable trophy: meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Spots tied to story areas can close off once you move on, so do this as you explore — meditate at every spot you find and clear each region before leaving it. Do not leave it for the endgame.
phases.goal: Meditate at every spot before it closes off
phases.tip: Tick spots off in the checklist as you go. One missed spot can cost a whole playthrough.
phases.title: Phase 2 — The one missable

phases.description: Nine trophies each hinge on a single moment: lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob three shops in a row, five kills in one Combat Focus, an unscheduled airport departure, a silent jewelry heist, five bank vaults, an armored truck, a showroom escape and a melee drive-by at the bowling alley. Make a manual save before every one of them — if the moment fails, reload the save and set it up again.
phases.goal: Nine single-attempt moments, each with a manual save
phases.tip: Save before, attempt, reload if it fails. Never attempt a one-shot without a save.
phases.title: Phase 3 — Nine one-shots

phases.description: Finish the stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest — plus Bret's hunt and Cal's fishing challenge. Eight finished strands earn the Strangers & Freaks silver. Strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for new markers between story missions.
phases.goal: Eight stranger strands, including the silver
phases.tip: Work one stranger at a time. A strand's final mission is its trophy.
phases.title: Phase 4 — Strangers & Freaks

phases.description: The long tail: 250 stunts, every activity tried once, gold on every shooting-range lane, drone races at every location, 20 race wins, card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 50 challenges, 100 vehicles, the Rhino, every region explored, an operation per gang, bowling, the secret moments, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, every garage bought and 10 vehicles registered. Do them in any order — the counters are cumulative.
phases.tip: Pair the driving with the collecting: explore for the regions while you hunt cards, vehicles and WAiNK spots.
phases.title: Phase 5 — Open-world cleanup

phases.description: When everything else is done, the in-game completion checklist should read 100% — that is A Long Road, the second gold. The moment it pops, the platinum follows: Vice Got a Price! is yours.
phases.goal: A Long Road, then Vice Got a Price!
phases.tip: Check the stats screen after every phase. The checklist tells you what is left.
phases.title: Phase 6 — 100% and the platinum

title: Roadmap to the platinum
